thesis.en: A coordinated regime of low-real-yield engineering + strategic re-industrialization. The Fed under Warsh institutionalizes a narrower, more discretionary, framework-resetting central bank (strict 2% target, less unconventional easing, no self-binding forward guidance), while Treasury under Bessent runs explicit yield suppression via bill-heavy issuance, buybacks, dealer-intermediation reform, and a de-facto funding alignment with the Fed. Industrial policy (advanced-chip tariffs, nuclear-for-AI) steers capital toward strategic domestic capacity.
thesis.zh: 一个协调一致的“压低实际收益率 + 战略再工业化”政策体制。沃什治下的美联储将其制度化为一个更收窄、更具相机抉择、重置框架的央行（严格2%目标、减少非常规宽松、不再自缚式前瞻指引）；贝森特治下的财政部则通过偏短端发债、回购、做市商中介改革，以及与美联储事实上的融资协同，明确压低收益率。产业政策（先进芯片关税、为AI供电的核能）将资本引向战略性国内产能。

regime_read.en: The market-relevant divergence: the consensus narrative casts Warsh as a dovish Trump instrument (Warren's 'sock puppet'), yet his revealed debut was a hawkish hold with a possible-hike dot. The low-yield outcome the administration wants is being pursued STRUCTURALLY — framework reset, balance-sheet posture, and Treasury issuance — not via near-term cuts. Trade the structure, not the rhetoric.
regime_read.zh: 对市场最关键的背离：主流叙事把沃什描绘成特朗普的鸽派工具（沃伦称其“提线木偶”），但他实际的首秀却是鹰派按兵不动、并暗示年内可能加息。政府想要的低收益率结果，是通过“结构性”手段实现的——框架重置、资产负债表姿态、财政部发债结构——而非近期降息。交易结构，而非言辞。

profile.en: Warsh's revealed agenda (CFR confirmation-hearing analysis + his June 17 debut): narrow the Fed's mandate, revert to a strict 2% target (abandoning 2020 flexible-average-inflation-targeting), cut reliance on unconventional tools (QE/balance sheet), and abandon forward guidance — potentially making the dot plot obsolete. He withheld his own dot, dropped guidance, issued a ~114-word statement, and chartered five reform task forces. Revealed interest: a personal institutional legacy / structural Fed redesign that outlasts any one president.
profile.zh: 沃什的实际议程（CFR对其确认听证会的分析 + 6月17日首秀）：收窄美联储职责、回归严格2%目标（放弃2020年的灵活平均通胀目标制）、减少对非常规工具（QE/资产负债表）的依赖、并放弃前瞻指引——点阵图或将作废。他未提交自己的点位、取消指引、发布约114词的声明、并设立五个改革工作组。其真实利益：打造个人的制度遗产 / 一个能超越任一总统任期的结构性美联储重设。

task_forces.charter_en: Review Fed communications, the SEP/dot-plot, transcript release practice, and the press conference; recommendations due ~end-2026; the vote on changes is deferred until it reports.
task_forces.charter_zh: 审查美联储沟通方式、SEP/点阵图、纪要发布做法及新闻发布会；建议约于2026年底出炉；相关变更的表决推迟至其汇报后。
task_forces.realpolitik_en: Institutionalizes killing forward guidance and the dot plot — more chair discretion, less market self-binding.
task_forces.realpolitik_zh: 将“废除前瞻指引与点阵图”制度化——主席相机抉择空间更大，对市场的自我约束更少。

task_forces.charter_en: Reconsider the Fed's balance-sheet framework and tools.
task_forces.charter_zh: 重新审视美联储的资产负债表框架与工具。
task_forces.realpolitik_en: Codifies a smaller, less-interventionist balance sheet and the 'bills-from-MBS' reinvestment that conveniently aids Treasury's bill-heavy funding (the Fed/Treasury nexus).
task_forces.realpolitik_zh: 将“更小、更少干预的资产负债表”及“以MBS回流资金购买短期国库券”的再投资姿态制度化——恰好配合财政部偏短端的融资需求（美联储/财政部联结点）。

task_forces.charter_en: Review the Fed's use of and reliance on existing data sources.
task_forces.charter_zh: 审查美联储对现有数据来源的使用与依赖。
task_forces.realpolitik_en: Revisits which data the Fed trusts (deemphasizing soft/lagging series), widening interpretive latitude for policy.
task_forces.realpolitik_zh: 重新界定美联储信任哪些数据（弱化软性/滞后序列），为政策解读拓宽空间。

task_forces.charter_en: Study productivity and jobs in an era of transformation (AI).
task_forces.charter_zh: 研究AI变革时代下的生产率与就业。
task_forces.realpolitik_en: Builds the intellectual case that AI lifts productivity/potential growth — justification to tolerate stronger demand without hiking. A supply-side narrative aligned with the administration's AI-dominance agenda.
task_forces.realpolitik_zh: 构建“AI提升生产率/潜在增长”的理论依据——为“容忍更强需求而不加息”背书。这一供给侧叙事与政府的AI主导议程一致。

task_forces.charter_zh: 重新检视美联储的通胀框架。
task_forces.realpolitik_en: The vehicle to formally bury 2020 FAIT and lock in a strict 2% target — the doctrinal core of the reset.
task_forces.realpolitik_zh: 正式埋葬2020年FAIT、锁定严格2%目标的载体——本次重置的教义核心。

staffing_note.en: Each task force pairs internal Fed staff with external experts Warsh is 'still recruiting' — NO external members named as of the June 17 debut. First named member is itself a tracked signal.
staffing_note.zh: 每个工作组由美联储内部人员搭配外部专家组成，沃什表示仍在“招募中”——截至6月17日首秀尚无外部成员公布。首位公布的成员本身即是一个被追踪的信号。

decision_makers_zh: 能源部长赖特（能源/核能）

grand_strategy.en: Treasury's revealed strategy under Bessent is yield suppression — 'Making America Affordable Again' — via short-end/bill-heavy funding rather than long-end coupons or deficit elimination, plus market-structure reform to expand dealer capacity to absorb Treasuries (eSLR reform, SEC central-clearing, buyback expansion). The objective Bessent states plainly: keep the risk-free rate low to lower mortgage and car payments. Pair this with concrete industrial policy (chip tariffs, nuclear-for-AI) and the picture is reflation-with-repression: hold real yields down while steering capital into strategic domestic capacity.
grand_strategy.zh: 贝森特治下财政部的实际策略是压低收益率——“让美国重新负担得起”——通过偏短端/票据为主的发债（而非增加长端票息或消除赤字），并辅以扩大做市商承接国债能力的市场结构改革（eSLR改革、SEC中央清算、扩大回购）。贝森特直言其目标：压低无风险利率以降低房贷与车贷。再叠加具体的产业政策（芯片关税、为AI供电的核能），整体图景即“带金融抑制的再通胀”：压住实际收益率，同时把资本引向战略性国内产能。

verified_levers.title_zh: 偏短端发债（“贝森特托底”）
verified_levers.detail_en: Treasury guided it likely will NOT change coupon auction sizes for several quarters, using T-bills as the issuance 'shock absorber' (SB0314, Nov 2025; held at Feb & May 2026 refundings).
verified_levers.detail_zh: 财政部已指引未来数个季度很可能不调整票息拍卖规模，以短期国库券作为发债的“减震器”（SB0314，2025年11月；并在2026年2月与5月再融资中维持）。

verified_levers.detail_en: Buyback program expanded (counterparty set widened H1 2026, final amendments Mar 30 2026), eSLR reform supported, SEC central-clearing backed — all to clear dealer balance-sheet capacity to absorb Treasuries.
verified_levers.detail_zh: 扩大回购计划（2026年上半年扩大交易对手范围，3月30日定稿修订）、支持eSLR改革、支持SEC中央清算——皆为释放做市商资产负债表空间以承接国债。

verified_levers.title_zh: 事实上的美联储/财政部融资联结
verified_levers.detail_en: Bessent explicitly cites the FOMC's shift to buying T-bills with MBS-runoff proceeds as a development that aids Treasury's bill-heavy funding. (FACT: the Fed reinvestment. INFERENCE: 'alignment' is the analyst's read.)
verified_levers.detail_zh: 贝森特明确将FOMC“以MBS回流资金购买短期国库券”列为有助于其偏短端融资的进展。（事实：美联储的再投资；推断：“协同”为分析判断。）

verified_levers.detail_en: Jan 14 2026 Section 232 25% tariff on certain advanced computing chips, naming NVIDIA H200 & AMD MI325X. NOTE: a reshoring exemption for fab-input chips was REFUTED — do not assume a clean domestic-fab carve-out.
verified_levers.detail_zh: 2026年1月14日依据232条款对部分先进计算芯片征收25%关税，点名英伟达H200与AMD MI325X。注意：所谓“为建厂进口芯片豁免”已被证伪——不要假设存在干净的国内建厂豁免。

verified_levers.detail_en: EO 14299 (May 23 2025): quadruple nuclear to 400 GW by 2050; 3 pilot reactors to criticality by Jul 4 2026; ≥20 MT HALEU released for private/AI projects; AI/critical-infra reactor by Oct 2027; DoD reactor. CAVEAT: targets are aspirational and slipping (only 1–2 of 3 pilots may hit Jul 4; Antares Mark-0 reached criticality early June 2026).
verified_levers.detail_zh: 第14299号行政令（2025年5月23日）：到2050年将核电翻两番至400吉瓦；3座试点反应堆于2026年7月4日前达临界；释放≥20公吨HALEU用于私营/AI项目；2027年10月前建成AI/关键基础设施反应堆；国防部反应堆。警告：目标偏理想且在滑期（3座试点或仅1–2座能赶上7月4日；Antares Mark-0已于2026年6月初达临界）。

theaters.title_en: China — tech war in a negotiated PAUSE
theaters.title_zh: 中国 —— 科技战处于谈判暂停期
theaters.facts_en: Nov 10 2025 US-China deal: fentanyl tariff cut 10pp; the reciprocal-tariff truce extended to Nov 10 2026 (10% stays). China to issue general licenses for rare earths / gallium / germanium / antimony / graphite and suspend its expanded rare-earth controls; both sides suspend post-Mar-2025 retaliation. SEPARATELY structural: USTR Section 301 semiconductor determination (Dec 29 2025; initial 0%, scheduled step-up ~Jun 23 2027) + the Jan 14 2026 25% advanced-chip tariff. CRITICAL RISK: the IEEPA tariff stack (the bulk of the wall) is legally contingent on a pending SCOTUS ruling — courts found overreach; tariffs stay in force pending review.
theaters.facts_zh: 2025年11月10日美中协议：芬太尼关税下调10个百分点；对等关税休战延长至2026年11月10日（10%保留）。中国将为稀土/镓/锗/锑/石墨发放一般许可并暂停其扩大的稀土管制；双方暂停2025年3月以来的反制。另有结构性动作：USTR 232/301半导体认定（2025年12月29日，初始0%，约2027年6月23日上调）+ 2026年1月14日25%先进芯片关税。关键风险：IEEPA关税体系（关税墙主体）在法律上取决于最高法院待决裁决——法院已认定越权，裁决前关税仍生效。
theaters.realpolitik_en: Revealed posture is managed DE-RISKING, not decoupling: a tariff truce buys rare-earth supply and calm into 2026 while the structural chip/AI controls (Section 301, export rules) keep tightening. The headline 'trade war' is paused; the tech war is not. Watch the SCOTUS ruling as a binary on the whole tariff edifice.
theaters.realpolitik_zh: 真实姿态是“管理式去风险”而非脱钩：关税休战换取稀土供应与2026年的平静，同时结构性芯片/AI管制（301条款、出口规则）持续收紧。头条“贸易战”已暂停，科技战未停。最高法院裁决是整座关税大厦的二元变量。
theaters.capital_en: Two-sided: truce relieves rare-earth/critical-minerals supply (caps a squeeze) yet the de-risking mandate still funds domestic minerals & chip onshoring; a SCOTUS strike-down would unwind the tariff-protection premium.
theaters.capital_zh: 两面性：休战缓解稀土/关键矿产供应（抑制逼空），但去风险使命仍为国内矿产与芯片回流提供资金；最高法院推翻关税将瓦解关税保护溢价。

theaters.title_en: Iran / Middle East — fragile ceasefire after a 2026 war
theaters.title_zh: 伊朗/中东 —— 2026年战争后的脆弱停火
theaters.facts_en: A ~6-week 2026 Iran war pushed oil to ~$100/bbl (highest since 2022) as shipping lanes went offline; Apr 8 2026 a Pakistan-mediated conditional ceasefire; by Jun 14 2026 a US-Iran ceasefire with the Strait of Hormuz reopening. Talks (Pakistan-mediated) cover Hormuz navigation, nuclear/missile limits, sanctions. GAP: the US 15-point plan demands Iran END all enrichment; Iran insists on the right to enrich + sanctions lifted — NOT agreed. Deal is unsigned/fragile.
theaters.facts_zh: 约6周的2026年伊朗战争一度将油价推升至约100美元/桶（2022年以来最高），航道一度中断；2026年4月8日达成巴基斯坦斡旋的有条件停火；至2026年6月14日美伊停火、霍尔木兹海峡重开。谈判（巴方斡旋）涵盖霍尔木兹通航、核/导弹限制、制裁。分歧：美方15点方案要求伊朗停止一切浓缩；伊朗坚持浓缩权+解除制裁——尚未达成。协议未签、脆弱。
theaters.realpolitik_en: The administration optimizes for cheap oil + deterrence + a deal it can brand. Hormuz reopening = a deliberate disinflation lever (helps the Fed/Treasury low-yield agenda). But the enrichment gap means re-escalation risk is live; the oil-down trade is policy-contingent, not structural.
theaters.realpolitik_zh: 政府的优化目标是低油价+威慑+可宣传的协议。霍尔木兹重开是有意的反通胀杠杆（助力美联储/财政部的低收益率议程）。但浓缩分歧意味着再升级风险仍在；油价下行交易取决于政策，而非结构性。
theaters.capital_en: Oil two-sided around headlines (re-escalation = spike; durable deal = fade). Energy was the TOP ETF-inflow sector in Q1 2026 (first in years) on the conflict — the rotation is real but headline-fragile. Defense bid persists regardless.
theaters.capital_zh: 油价随头条两面波动（再升级=飙升；持久协议=回落）。2026年一季度能源是ETF净流入最多的板块（多年来首次），但该轮动易受头条左右。无论如何国防仍获买盘。

theaters.title_en: NATO / Defense — a structural spending super-cycle
theaters.title_zh: 北约/国防 —— 结构性开支超级周期
theaters.facts_en: NATO Hague Summit (Jun 2025): allies committed to 5% of GDP by 2035 (3.5% core + 1.5% related). US FY2027 defense request = $1.5T ($1.15T discretionary + $350B reconciliation) = +24% real vs FY2026 discretionary, +38% incl. reconciliation. FY2026 DoD appropriation $839.2B (signed Feb 3 2026). FY2025 reconciliation added $152.3B DoD (5-yr availability). Priorities: shipbuilding, Golden Dome / missile defense, munitions, drones.
theaters.facts_zh: 北约海牙峰会（2025年6月）：盟国承诺2035年前国防开支达GDP的5%（3.5%核心+1.5%相关）。美国FY2027国防申请=1.5万亿美元（1.15万亿可自由支配+0.35万亿对账拨款）=较FY2026实际增长24%，含对账增长38%。FY2026国防部拨款8392亿（2026年2月3日签署）。FY2025对账法新增国防部1523亿（5年可用）。优先：造船、金穹/导弹防御、弹药、无人机。
theaters.realpolitik_en: This is the most durable, least-headline-fragile rotation in the whole map — multi-year, bipartisan, treaty-locked (2035), and funded through both appropriations AND reconciliation. Revealed intent: re-industrialize the defense base + force allied procurement of US primes.
theaters.realpolitik_zh: 这是整张地图中最持久、最不受头条左右的轮动——多年、两党、条约锁定（2035）、且通过常规拨款与对账双渠道融资。真实意图：重建国防工业基础+迫使盟国采购美国军工巨头。
theaters.capital_en: Targeted/high-confidence: defense primes + shipbuilding + missile-defense/Golden Dome + munitions + drones. Proxies ITA, XAR, PPA, SHLD.
theaters.capital_zh: 受益/高置信：军工巨头+造船+导弹防御/金穹+弹药+无人机。代理 ITA、XAR、PPA、SHLD。

theaters.title_en: Dollar / debt — real policy vs the 'Mar-a-Lago' theory
theaters.title_zh: 美元/债务 —— 真实政策 vs “海湖庄园”理论
theaters.facts_en: REAL, enacted: the GENIUS Act — Treasury (Bessent) explicitly frames stablecoins as driving 'a surge in demand for US Treasuries' and 'dollar supremacy' (a funding channel for the debt). THEORY, not policy: the 'Mar-a-Lago Accord' (a 'dominant-but-weaker' dollar via coordinated CB intervention — foreign CBs swap into 50-100yr low-coupon bonds; IEEPA 'user fee' on foreign Treasury holdings; gold revaluation). CORRECTIONS: Stephen Miran AUTHORED the framework as FORMER CEA chair — he is NOT on the Fed Board and is NOT the current CEA chair (both widely-circulated claims are FALSE).
theaters.facts_zh: 真实、已立法：GENIUS法案——财政部（贝森特）明确将稳定币定位为推动“美债需求激增”与“美元至上”（一条债务融资渠道）。理论、非政策：“海湖庄园协议”（通过协同央行干预实现“强势但偏弱”的美元——外国央行换入50-100年低息债券；依IEEPA对外国持有美债征“使用费”；黄金重估）。更正：斯蒂芬·米兰以“前”CEA主席身份提出该框架——他并不在美联储理事会、也不是现任CEA主席（两种流传说法均为假）。
theaters.realpolitik_en: The enacted lever is the GENIUS/stablecoin → T-bill demand channel (reinforces the Bessent bill-heavy, low-yield agenda). The Mar-a-Lago dollar-devaluation is a SCENARIO to monitor, not a base case — don't trade it as policy. The honest read: financial repression is happening via issuance + stablecoin demand, not (yet) via overt currency realignment.
theaters.realpolitik_zh: 已落地的杠杆是GENIUS/稳定币→短债需求渠道（强化贝森特偏短端、低收益率议程）。海湖庄园式美元贬值是需监测的“情景”，而非基准——不要把它当政策来交易。诚实解读：金融抑制正通过发债结构+稳定币需求发生，而非（目前）通过公开的货币重整。
theaters.capital_en: Reinforces front-end Treasuries + the low-real-yield regime; stablecoin issuers/rails a structural T-bill bid. A genuine Mar-a-Lago turn (low odds) would be dollar-bearish / gold-bullish — a tail to watch, not own.
theaters.capital_zh: 强化短端美债+低实际收益率体制；稳定币发行方/通道形成结构性短债买盘。真正的海湖庄园转向（概率低）将利空美元/利多黄金——属待观察尾部，而非持仓。

targeted.mechanism_zh: 第14299号行政令翻两番至400吉瓦；为AI释放HALEU；国防部/试点反应堆

targeted.mechanism_zh: 25%的232条款芯片关税挤压进口渠道（无已核实的建厂进口豁免）

targeted.mechanism_zh: eSLR改革+中央清算+扩大回购，缓解银行承接国债的约束

targeted.mechanism_zh: 偏短端发债+压低收益率+美联储以MBS资金购买短债

starved.theme_zh: 依赖进口的先进芯片渠道
starved.mechanism_en: 25% tariff raises cost of imported compute (H200/MI325X named)
starved.mechanism_zh: 25%关税抬高进口算力成本（点名H200/MI325X）

starved.mechanism_zh: 若压低收益率持续，与“贝森特托底”对抗的资产（政策博弈中，并非干净的做空）

starved.theme_zh: 依赖透明指引的利率波动率策略
starved.mechanism_en: A less-predictable communications regime raises event-vol around a guidance-free Fed
starved.mechanism_zh: 更不可预测的沟通体制抬高了“无指引美联储”前后的事件性波动

predictions.text_en: Fed releases a revised SEP/communications framework (new dot-plot format, or formal discontinuation, or transcript/presser changes).
predictions.text_zh: 美联储发布修订后的SEP/沟通框架（点阵图改版、正式停用、或纪要/发布会变更）。

predictions.text_en: Inflation-frameworks task force formally recommends abandoning 2020 FAIT for a strict 2% target.
predictions.text_zh: 通胀框架工作组正式建议放弃2020年FAIT、回归严格2%目标。

predictions.text_en: Warsh keeps withholding his own dot OR the dot plot is suspended over the next 2–3 meetings.
predictions.text_zh: 未来2–3次会议中，沃什继续不提交自己的点位，或点阵图被暂停。

predictions.text_en: At least one named external task-force expert is announced.
predictions.text_zh: 至少公布一位具名的外部工作组专家。

predictions.text_en: The Fed does NOT cut at the July and September 2026 meetings (hold or hike). Falsified by any 2026 cut ahead of the median path.
predictions.text_zh: 美联储在2026年7月与9月会议上不降息（按兵或加息）。若年内先于中值路径降息则证伪。

predictions.text_en: No coupon auction-size INCREASE at the Aug 2026 refunding (bills stay the shock absorber). Falsified by any coupon-size hike.
predictions.text_zh: 2026年8月再融资不上调票息拍卖规模（短债仍为减震器）。若上调票息规模则证伪。

predictions.text_en: Treasury keeps publicly framing policy as keeping the risk-free rate low / affordability.
predictions.text_zh: 财政部继续公开将政策表述为压低无风险利率/可负担性。

predictions.text_en: Concrete eSLR-reform progress (a proposed or final rule from a banking regulator).
predictions.text_zh: eSLR改革取得具体进展（银行监管机构出台拟议或最终规则）。

predictions.text_en: SEC advances Treasury central-clearing expansion (a rule or compliance milestone).
predictions.text_zh: SEC推进国债中央清算扩容（规则或合规里程碑）。

predictions.text_en: The Fed keeps reinvesting MBS runoff into T-bills through 2026.
predictions.text_zh: 美联储在2026年内持续将MBS回流资金再投资于短期国库券。

predictions.text_en: The 25% advanced-chip tariff stays in force (not rescinded) and/or the covered list expands.
predictions.text_zh: 25%先进芯片关税继续生效（未被撤销）且/或覆盖清单扩大。

predictions.text_en: At least one of the three pilot reactors reaches criticality (partial-pass already likely — Antares Mark-0, early June 2026).
predictions.text_zh: 三座试点反应堆中至少一座达临界（已可能部分达成——Antares Mark-0，2026年6月初）。

predictions.text_en: DOE releases ≥20 MT HALEU into the fuel bank for private/AI projects.
predictions.text_zh: 美国能源部向燃料库释放≥20公吨HALEU用于私营/AI项目。

predictions.text_en: The AI/critical-infrastructure reactor program shows a contracted/sited project.
predictions.text_zh: AI/关键基础设施反应堆计划出现已签约/选址的项目。

predictions.text_en: Nuclear/uranium proxies (URA/URNM/SMR/OKLO/CCJ) outperform the S&P 500 over the next 2 quarters. Falsified by sustained underperformance.
predictions.text_zh: 核能/铀代理（URA/URNM/SMR/OKLO/CCJ）未来两个季度跑赢标普500。若持续跑输则证伪。

predictions.text_en: Front-end Treasury demand stays robust (bill auctions well-covered, no forced coupon shift).
predictions.text_zh: 短端美债需求保持强劲（票据拍卖认购充分，未被迫调整票息）。

predictions.text_en: Financials/dealer-bank proxies (XLF) benefit on eSLR-reform headlines.
predictions.text_zh: 金融/做市商银行代理（XLF）受益于eSLR改革相关消息。

predictions.text_en: Long-duration Treasuries (TLT) do NOT sustain a term-premium blowout that overrides the suppression campaign in H2 2026. Falsified by a disorderly long-end selloff.
predictions.text_zh: 长久期美债（TLT）在2026下半年不出现压过压制行动的期限溢价飙升。若长端无序抛售则证伪。

predictions.text_en: The US-China reciprocal-tariff truce holds (no return above the 10% reciprocal rate) through its Nov 10 2026 expiry.
predictions.text_zh: 美中对等关税休战维持（不回升至10%以上），直至2026年11月10日到期。

predictions.text_en: If SCOTUS strikes the IEEPA tariff authority, the administration re-imposes equivalent protection via Section 232/301 (the tariff wall is not dismantled).
predictions.text_zh: 若最高法院推翻IEEPA关税权限，政府将通过232/301条款重新施加等效保护（关税墙不被拆除）。

predictions.text_en: The Section 301 semiconductor tariff steps up above 0% on/around its scheduled ~Jun 23 2027 date.
predictions.text_zh: 301条款半导体关税在约2027年6月23日的预定日期前后上调至0%以上。

predictions.text_en: The US-Iran ceasefire holds with no full re-closure of the Strait of Hormuz through Q3 2026.
predictions.text_zh: 美伊停火维持，2026年三季度前霍尔木兹海峡未再全面关闭。

predictions.text_en: No signed comprehensive US-Iran nuclear deal by Q3 2026 (the enrichment gap persists).
predictions.text_zh: 2026年三季度前未签署全面的美伊核协议（浓缩分歧仍在）。

predictions.text_en: Enacted US FY2027 defense topline lands as a real increase over FY2026 (toward the $1.5T request).
predictions.text_zh: 已通过的美国FY2027国防总额较FY2026实际增长（趋向1.5万亿申请）。

predictions.text_en: No rollback of the NATO Hague 5%-by-2035 pledge; aggregate allied defense spending keeps rising.
predictions.text_zh: 北约海牙“2035年5%”承诺未被推翻；盟国国防开支总额持续上升。

predictions.text_en: Defense proxies (ITA/XAR/PPA/SHLD) outperform the S&P 500 over the next 2 quarters.
predictions.text_zh: 国防代理（ITA/XAR/PPA/SHLD）未来两个季度跑赢标普500。

predictions.text_en: Stablecoin reserves' Treasury holdings rise materially in 2026 (the GENIUS-Act funding channel operates as Treasury frames it).
predictions.text_zh: 2026年稳定币储备所持美债显著上升（GENIUS法案融资渠道如财政部所述运作）。

predictions.text_en: NO enacted 'Mar-a-Lago Accord' action (IEEPA user-fee on foreign Treasuries or coordinated dollar devaluation) by year-end — it stays theory.
predictions.text_zh: 年底前未出台任何“海湖庄园协议”行动（对外国持有美债征IEEPA使用费或协同美元贬值）——仍停留于理论。

predictions.text_en: Oil does NOT sustain >$100/bbl absent a Hormuz re-closure (the ceasefire holds as a disinflation lever).
predictions.text_zh: 在霍尔木兹未再关闭的情况下，油价不持续高于100美元/桶（停火作为反通胀杠杆维持）。

caveats.en: China / Iran / NATO threads are now PRIMARY-SOURCED (Nov-2025 China deal, 2026 Iran ceasefire, NATO Hague 5%, FY2027 $1.5T defense, GENIUS Act). KEY CORRECTIONS: the 'Mar-a-Lago Accord' is a THEORY, not enacted policy — don't trade it as base case; Stephen Miran authored it as FORMER CEA chair and is NOT on the Fed Board / NOT current CEA chair. CONTINGENCIES: the IEEPA tariff stack is legally pending a SCOTUS ruling; the China truce is a PAUSE (expires Nov 10 2026) not peace; the Iran ceasefire is unsigned/fragile (enrichment gap). Realpolitik reads, all ticker proxies, and market-outcome predictions (P15–P18, P26, P29) are INFERENCE, not source-endorsed. Nuclear targets are aspirational and slipping; the chip-tariff reshoring-exemption was REFUTED. Time-sensitive; re-verify before trading. Context only — not investment advice.
caveats.zh: 中国/伊朗/北约线索现已有一手来源（2025年11月美中协议、2026年伊朗停火、北约海牙5%、FY2027 1.5万亿国防、GENIUS法案）。关键更正：“海湖庄园协议”是理论而非已落地政策——勿当基准交易；斯蒂芬·米兰以“前”CEA主席身份提出，并不在美联储理事会、也非现任CEA主席。或有变数：IEEPA关税体系在法律上待最高法院裁决；中国休战是暂停（2026年11月10日到期）而非和平；伊朗停火未签、脆弱（浓缩分歧）。realpolitik解读、所有代理标的、及市场结果类预测（P15–P18、P26、P29）均为推断。核能目标偏理想且在滑期；芯片关税建厂豁免已被证伪。具时效性，交易前请重新核实。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。
